tools.name: stats
tools.description: What this deployment holds: collections, sources, items, items added today, feeds.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: The collections (niches) with their source, feed and item counts.

tools.name: list_adapters
tools.description: Every adapter this deployment can run, with the config fields each takes. Use before add_source.

tools.name: list_enrichers
tools.description: Every enricher (YouTube videos, Wikipedia, repo stats, downloads, company profiles, TL;DRs) and which collections turn it on by default. Items carry their results under `enrichment`.

tools.name: list_sources
tools.description: Sources with status, last run and item counts. Optionally one collection.

tools.name: list_feeds
tools.description: Public feeds, most followed first. Optionally one collection.

tools.name: feed_items
tools.description: What a feed selects, newest first. Page with before_id.

tools.name: recent_items
tools.description: Newest items, optionally narrowed to a collection, source or kind.

tools.name: upcoming
tools.description: Items dated in the future (releases, launches, deadlines), soonest first.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Full-text search over titles, summaries and tags. Use this first when you know a name.

tools.name: match_items

Give a file name, a release name or a playlist entry ("Top.Gun.Maverick.2022.1080p.mkv", "US: ESPN2 HD"); it is cleaned (year, season and episode, quality tags, playlist decorations) and matched by similarity. tools.name: get_item
tools.description: One item with its full adapter payload.

tools.name: population
tools.description: Population and demography, drilled down from the world to the ZIP code. Give a `key` (us, us-ca, us-ca-los-angeles, gb, gb-england-london), a US `zip`, or a place name in `q`; no argument is the world. Answers with the area (population, year, measures: age, income, home value, rent, poverty, educati

tools.name: where_to_buy_book
tools.description: Where to buy a book. Give an `isbn` (10 or 13 digits, hyphens fine), or a `title` and `author`, or `item` (a books-collection item id). Answers with the edition from Open Library (title, authors, publisher, pages, cover), `online`: links at Amazon, Bookshop.org, Barnes & Noble, Books-A-Million, Targ

tools.name: create_feed
tools.description: Save a query as a feed (needs a key). Sources, kinds and tags narrow; q is a text match; upcoming keeps only future-dated items.

tools.name: follow_feed
tools.description: Follow a feed as the key owner (needs a key). Channels: webpush, email, webhook.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: The key owner's account webhook endpoints (never their secrets) and the event types this site emits. Needs a key.

tools.name: create_webhook
tools.description: Add an account webhook: signed POSTs (Standard Webhooks + CloudEvents) to an https URL for events such as feed.item.published (new items in feeds you follow), feed.followed, feed.created, submission.approved. Patterns like feed.* work; omit events for all. Returns the signing secret. Needs a key.

tools.name: update_webhook
tools.description: Change an account webhook: url, events, description, or enabled (true turns it back on and clears its failure count). Needs a key.

tools.name: delete_webhook
tools.description: Remove an account webhook and its delivery log. Needs a key.

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send a webhook.test event to one of your endpoints now and report the HTTP status. Needs a key.

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Replace a webhook signing secret; the old one stops working at once. Returns the new secret. Needs a key.

tools.name: webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Recent webhook deliveries with status, attempts, last error and payload: for one endpoint, or all of yours. Needs a key.

tools.name: submit_feed
tools.description: Suggest an RSS or Atom feed for the index. No key needed. An admin reviews every suggestion before anything is fetched; approved podcast feeds are handed to rssamplifier, everything else becomes a source here.

tools.name: search_profiles
tools.description: People: one entry per person assembled from every app that serves their OpenProfile.md (podcasters from p0dcasters, public profiles from OutreachGraph). Search by name, headline or anything in the document; newest change first. Each answer carries the page, the openprofile.md URL, accounts, topics,

tools.name: find_profile_by_linkedin
tools.description: The public profile a LinkedIn profile or company URL belongs to (linkedin.com/in/… or /company/…), or null. LinkedIn only: profiles are never looked up by email.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: One person by id, `<slug>-<id>` or handle: the parsed view and the OpenProfile.md as served.

tools.name: claim_profile
tools.description: Claim a profile as the key owner (needs a key). Proven when the key owner’s email is one the profile lists, or when the person’s site or show page links back to the profile’s nichedb page. An admin may claim on behalf of an email.

tools.name: update_profile
tools.description: Edit a profile you own (needs a key). Send `markdown`, a whole OpenProfile.md that replaces what you wrote before, or any of `name`, `headline`, `emoji`, `pronouns`, `web`, `identity` (key: value, null removes), `sections` (name: body, `none` removes), `handle`, `public`. What you write wins over ev

tools.name: add_source
tools.description: Add a source: an adapter with a config, fetched on a schedule (needs a key; admins and Pro). Call list_adapters first for the fields.

tools.name: run_source
tools.description: Fetch a source now instead of waiting for its schedule (needs a key; owner or admin).

tools.name: search_tlds
tools.description: Top-level domains: every label in IANA's root, with type, registry, RDAP server and each registrar's one-year register/renew/transfer price (Porkbun, Dynadot, Cloudflare, OVHcloud). Sorted by renewal by default, because the first year is a promotion. `best` is the cheapest USD price across registrar

tools.name: get_tld
tools.description: One top-level domain: type, registry, RDAP server, when it entered or left the root, every registrar price (register, renew, transfer, restore, promotions, privacy, restrictions) and its change history.

tools.name: tld_changes
tools.description: Top-level domains added to or removed from IANA's root, newest first, with the IANA list version each happened in. Nobody else publishes this diff.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Is a domain name registered? Asks each registry over RDAP. Give `name` as a full name (foo.watches), or a bare word with `tlds` (foo + com,dev,io), or several names comma separated. Each answer is registered (with registrar and expiry), not_registered, or unknown. not_registered means the registry h

tools.name: ship_lookup
tools.description: A ship or boat by MMSI (9 digits), IMO number (7 digits) or name, from open AIS (Digitraffic, northern Baltic). tools.name: transit_station
tools.description: Next arrivals and the timetable at a public transit station. Give `city` (nyc, boston, bay-area, chicago, london) and `station` (a station id from transit_city, or a name to match). Answers the station (lines, place, step-free), `arrivals` (line, toward, due time, minutes away; live from the agency)

tools.name: transit_city
tools.description: A city’s public transit now: its lines, its stations (id, name, lines), the service alerts in force and, with `vehicles: true`, every vehicle position the agency publishes. Cities: nyc, boston, bay-area, chicago, london, toronto, philadelphia.

tools.name: business_standing
tools.description: Is a business on anybody's list? Give its `name`, and any of `domain`, `state` (two letters), `number` (state entity number) and `ein`. tools.description: Is an IP address or a domain on a blocklist? Give `indicator` (an IPv4/IPv6 address or a domain; a URL is reduced to its host). Newest approvals first. Optional `days` keeps addresses s

tools.name: redeem_code
tools.description: Redeem a credit code (CR-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX) for the key owner. A code is worth days of Premium, added after any term already held. Needs a key.

tools.name: list_invites
tools.description: The key owner's invites: how many are left of the quota, and each invite with its status (open, used, expired, revoked). Needs a key.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make one invite link as the key owner. Invites are scarce (a few per account); when the invited person signs up, both get days of Premium. The link is returned once. Needs a key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_collections, list_feeds, search_profiles, reputation_lookup · Private data: match_items, list_webhooks, create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, search_profiles, airplane_lookup, satellite_lookup, ship_lookup, train_lookup, business_standing, reputation_lookup, vuln_lookup, traffic_list · Public sink: where_to_buy_book, follow_feed, list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, webhook_deliveries, submit_feed, search_profiles, find_profile_by_linkedin, claim_profile, update_profile · Destructive: list_adapters, list_sources, delete_webhook, run_source, train_lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_collections, list_feeds, search_profiles, reputation_lookup · Private data: match_items, list_webhooks, create_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, search_profiles, airplane_lookup, satellite_lookup, ship_lookup, train_lookup, business_standing, reputation_lookup, vuln_lookup, traffic_list · Public sink: where_to_buy_book, follow_feed, list_webhooks, create_webhook, update_webhook, delete_webhook, test_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, webhook_deliveries, submit_feed, search_profiles, find_profile_by_linkedin, claim_profile, update_profile · Destructive: list_adapters, list_sources, delete_webhook, run_source, train_lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
